# Support

Human Rounds Core is open-source software provided without a bundled service
agreement. This document separates community assistance from paid operational
commitments so deployers can plan honestly.

## Support channels

Use the public repository's issue and discussion channels for reproducible bug
reports, installation questions and proposed improvements. Use the private
reporting process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities. Never put
patient data, credentials or private deployment details in a public report.

## Response expectations

Community support is volunteer and best-effort. There is no guaranteed response
time, resolution time or service level. Security reports receive priority, but
priority is not a response-time guarantee. Operators remain responsible for
their deployment, access controls, backups, monitoring, clinical procedures and
continuity plan.

## LTS

The project does not currently promise a long-term-support release or a fixed
maintenance term. Releases and upgrade notes describe what is supported at that
time. A future LTS line must name its supported versions, maintenance window,
security scope and end date before anyone can rely on it.

## Commercial support

Generated Media, Inc. may offer separately contracted implementation,
integration, managed operations, upgrades, disaster recovery, priority support
or service levels. Commercial support changes only the customer's service
agreement; it does not remove AGPL rights from Human Rounds Core or create a
service obligation for community maintainers.
